{{Quote|It commemorates Gavail Kespan. He died defending the capital during the Wanderers' Siege.|Nadia Grell|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Wanderer's Siege''' was a conflict that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] where the [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] [[Gavail Kespan]] fought to defend the [[Sarkhai's capital city|capital city]]. Kespan [[Death/Legends|gave his life]] during the conflict, and the [[Annex of Kespan]] was built to commemorate his sacrifice for centuries to come.
